features.description: Backend GCS list + import API: tools/gcs_browser/ module with browser.py (validate_bucket_name, list_gcs_objects, import_gcs_object) and routes.py (GET /api/gcs/list, POST /api/gcs/import). Reuses _upload_to_gcs/_run_parse/_store_document from upload.py. Register router in fast_api_app.py. Add AP_DEMO_BUCKET env var.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/gcs/list?bucket=demo returns list of GCSObject items in tests
GET /api/gcs/list with mocked SA 403 returns JSON with sa_email field
POST /api/gcs/import with unsupported extension returns HTTP 400
cd backend && make lint && make test-fast passes

features.description: Frontend GCSFileBrowser sidebar component: useGCSBucket hook (calls /api/proxy/api/gcs/list), GCSFileItem (import button with loading states), GCSBucketInput (strips gs:// prefix, localStorage persistence), GCSFileBrowser (two accordion sections: Example Invoices + Your GCS Bucket, skeleton loader, empty/error states). Wire into page.tsx sidebar.
acceptance_criteria: Example Invoices accordion section renders with file list or empty state
Clicking Import shows 'Importing…' spinner then 'Done' state
Imported file appears in DocListView without page refresh (Firestore listener)
Your GCS Bucket input persists bucket name in localStorage across reloads
Invalid/denied bucket shows error with SA email address

features.description: Infrastructure: run setup-demo-bucket.sh to create GCS bucket and upload 9 demo invoice files, add _AP_DEMO_BUCKET substitution to cloudbuild.yaml, push to trigger Cloud Build deployment.
acceptance_criteria: gsutil ls gs://gde-ap-agent-demo-invoices/ lists 9 demo files
_AP_DEMO_BUCKET substitution present in cloudbuild.yaml backend deploy step
GET /api/proxy/api/gcs/list?bucket=demo returns objects from deployed frontend
git push to dev triggers Cloud Build successfully
